as_told.title: Bill Hamilton gives witness Brad S to Greer

plain: A researcher who posts online as UAPGerb (UAP is the official term for UFOs) says on the show of podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1997 a UFO researcher named William "Bill" Hamilton III, author of a book called Cosmic Top Secret, was in contact with Steven Greer, who ran the Disclosure Project, an effort to get witnesses to speak publicly about UFOs. According to UAPGerb, Hamilton passed witnesses on to Greer, including a primary witness he names only as Brad S. If so, some of the project's witnesses would have come to it through one researcher's contacts.
